annotations.title: Make a link for a file

description: Makes a link that opens one file of the library for anyone who holds it, without signing in. A link lasts 6 hours; a showcase page, which carries the Made with UGCFans badge, lasts 30 days. Free. Anyone with the link can see the file until it expires.

kind.description: link opens the file itself (default); showcase is a page that shows it.

path.description: The file's address in the library, out/...
